test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

India's market for electronic goods is __one of the large market__ in the world.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'One of the largest markets'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• An adjective is a word that describes a noun or a pronoun. 
 
• The **superlative** degree is used to describe an object out of a group.
 
 
• **Example**: Gold **is the most **precious metal.
 
 
 
• The noun after **'one of'** should always be **plural **in form. 
 
 
• **Example**: He is **one of the best writers** that have ever lived. 
 
 
 
• According to the rules and examples above, the sentence given in **option 2)** has the correct superlative degree.

 

**Correct sentence :__** *India's market for electric goods is **one of the largest markets** in the world .*
